title: Mediterranean sapropel microbial communities: data files
note: Column lists generated from the Parquet files with DuckDB DESCRIBE. Values such as thresholds and counts are in the files themselves.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Row key; joins meta.parquet to freq.parquet. 64-bit integer: read it as BIGINT or string, not as a float.

columns.name: sample
columns.description: Sample name: core and depth interval, e.g. GeoB15103-1_19-34cm. Matches samples.json.

columns.name: rank
columns.description: Taxonomic rank of the row. All rows are subspecies (one reference genome).

columns.name: taxid
columns.description: Taxon identifier used in the analysis.

columns.name: name
columns.description: Reference accession with an S__ prefix.

columns.name: reference
columns.description: Reference genome accession. Unique within a sample.

columns.name: domain
columns.description: Lineage, d__ prefix.

columns.name: phylum
columns.description: Lineage, p__ prefix.

columns.name: class_
columns.description: Lineage, c__ prefix.

columns.name: order_
columns.description: Lineage, o__ prefix.

columns.name: family
columns.description: Lineage, f__ prefix.

columns.name: genus
columns.description: Lineage, g__ prefix.

columns.name: species
columns.description: Lineage, s__ prefix.

columns.name: n_reads
columns.description: Reads assigned to the genome.

columns.name: n_alns
columns.description: Alignments assigned to the genome.

columns.name: n_refs
columns.description: Number of reference genomes contributing to the row (1 at subspecies rank).

columns.name: damage
columns.description: Damage estimate: A_b, or 0 when fit is bad. Range 0-1. Compared with damage_threshold in config.json.

columns.name: fit
columns.description: Fit flag from the analysis pipeline: good or bad.

columns.name: q
columns.description: metaDMG decay before bias correction.

columns.name: c
columns.description: metaDMG background before bias correction.

columns.name: phi
columns.description: metaDMG concentration before bias correction.

columns.name: significance
columns.description: metaDMG Z value of the fit (Zfit).

columns.name: A
columns.description: metaDMG amplitude before bias correction.

columns.name: A_b
columns.description: Amplitude A of the fit, bias-corrected in the analysis pipeline.

columns.name: q_b
columns.description: Decay q of the fit, bias-corrected.

columns.name: c_b
columns.description: Background c of the fit, bias-corrected.

columns.name: phi_b
columns.description: Beta-binomial concentration phi of the fit, bias-corrected.

columns.name: A_CI_l
columns.description: Lower bound of the interval for A.

columns.name: A_CI_h
columns.description: Upper bound of the interval for A.

columns.name: q_CI_l
columns.description: Lower bound of the interval for q.

columns.name: q_CI_h
columns.description: Upper bound of the interval for q.

columns.name: c_CI_l
columns.description: Lower bound of the interval for c.

columns.name: c_CI_h
columns.description: Upper bound of the interval for c.

columns.name: map_A
columns.description: Copy of A_b.

columns.name: map_q

columns.name: map_c

columns.name: map_phi

columns.name: map_damage

columns.name: map_significance

freq.parquet.description: Per-position substitution data, one row per row of meta.parquet.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Row key; joins meta.parquet to freq.parquet. 64-bit integer: read it as BIGINT or string, not as a float.

column_patterns.description: Observed C>T frequency at position {i} from the 5′ end.
Observed G>A frequency at position {i} from the 3′ end.
metaDMG fit of the C>T frequency at position {i} from the 5′ end.
metaDMG fit of the G>A frequency at position {i} from the 3′ end.
C>T count at position {i} from the 5′ end.
Number of reference C at position {i} from the 5′ end.
G>A count at position {i} from the 3′ end.
Number of reference G at position {i} from the 3′ end.

fields.name: specific_feature
fields.description: Layer: Sapropel1, Sapropel3, Sapropel5, Sapropel6 (sapropels S1, S3, S5, S6) or a non-sapropel label.

fields.name: age_ka
fields.description: Estimated age in thousands of years before present.

fields.name: sort_order
fields.description: Display order used by the build.

fields.name: damage_threshold
fields.description: A row is damaged when fit is not bad and damage is greater than this value.

fields.name: threshold_ref_sample
fields.description: Internal label of the sample whose damage distribution defines the threshold (third quartile of A_b among good fits).

fields.name: build_id
fields.description: Unix time of the data build; also used to bust caches.

fields.name: qc
fields.description: Coverage filters applied in the build: norm_entropy_gt, breadth_gt, breadth_exp_ratio_ge.

fields.name: min_reads
fields.description: Minimum read count passed to the build script.

fields.name: ranks
fields.description: Ranks the build script can emit. The published files contain subspecies rows only.
